messages:
Alex W: seeing a sudden spike of 502/504s for hosted API from the edge. started ~08:03 UTC, affects multiple guest tenants, high rate of retries visible. :frowning:
Alex W: sample curl that fails: `curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-guest-xxx' -H 'X-Tenant: guest-42' "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"input": "hello"}'` -> upstream reset / 502
Alex W: nginx/edge logs show repeated `upstream prematurely closed connection` and `502` paired with `queue_full` counters rising. attaching small excerpt:
```
[08:03:21] edge-proxy: tenant=guest-42 req_id=aa1 upstream_reset stream_id=7
[08:03:22] edge-proxy: tenant=guest-7 req_id=aa2 queue_length=1024 drop=1
[08:03:23] envoy: upstream: retried 4 times, last_status=502
```
Priya S: can you pull a trace id for one failing request and paste the request headers? also what model/route is most affected?
Alex W: trace id aa1 above. Affected route is /v1/generate (hostedapi, long-poll streaming customers plus embeddings batch jobs), model pinned to open-7b-q.
Ben T: looks like L7 queue saturation on frontdoor -> midproxy. I see a sudden climb in `l7_queue_depth` and `upstream_conn_wait` in grafana around 08:02. link: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/edge/queues (internal).
Ben T: metrics snapshot: `l7_queue_depth` per node 900-1200, `active_retries` spiking, `envoy_conn_pool_active` hitting pool_limit 64.
InfraBot: alert: high 5xx rate on hostedapi-edge (svc=edge-proxy-prod), 08:03:15 -> 08:06:00, 1m spike: 18.4% error rate. Incident ID I-202631555.
SupportOps: customers impacted: 7 tickets opened so far (TKT-1248, TKT-1249...), churned customer reports and a couple enterprise escalations inbound. Noted billing webhook timeouts too.
Priya S: possible causes: (1) traffic burst (batch embeddings from a partner job), (2) retry amplification from client SDKs, (3) upstream midproxy hitting conn/window limits. Need repro steps to validate.
James C: quick mitigations we can apply now: 1) reduce edge retry attempts from 4->1 for short window, 2) throttle per-tenant concurrency for guests (soft cap 8), 3) temporarily disable long tail keepalive reprioritization to free pools. I'm going to push a short live config change to the canary ring.
Ben T: will run `kubectl exec -it edge-proxy -- curl localhost:9901/stats | grep l7_queue` and paste results. can someone run a controlled repro?
Alex W: repro steps I used:
1) run 50 parallel clients hitting /v1/generate for tenant guest-42 with batch-size=32 embedding calls
2) include `Connection: keep-alive` and reuse SDK v0.9.2 (known to retry on 5xx)
Command:
```
for i in {1..50}; do 
  curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-guest-xxx' -H 'X-Tenant: guest-42' -d '{"input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings &
done
wait
```
Alex W: results: ~30% of requests returned 502/504, 10s median latency increased to 2.1s.
Priya S: thanks, that's solid. Ben, after James' canary change, can you validate if queue depth drops?
James C: pushed changes to canary: edge retry_count=1, tenant_soft_cap=8 for guest-* (10m window). watch for regressions. :rocket:
Ben T: canary metrics show l7_queue_depth on canary nodes dropping from ~1100 -> ~120 within 45s. active retries down 80%.
SupportOps: applied temporary customer messaging and paused scheduled bulk embeddings for a partner. Customers updated.
InfraBot: auto-note: config-change by James C at 08:06:12: `edge.retry_count=1 tenant.soft_cap.guest-*=8`
Alex W: after mitigation, error rate on affected tenants down to ~1.4% at 08:08. Good short-term. Need root cause postmortem.
Priya S: next actions: - eng-sre to capture full trace logs for window 08:00-08:10 (Ben/James) - product to contact partner who ran bulk embeddings and coordinate rate-limits (SupportOps) - infra to review conn pool sizing and h2 window defaults (eng-infra)
James C: assigning owners: eng-sre (Ben T), eng-infra (Priya S), product outreach (SupportOps). I'll keep the soft cap until EOD and revert based on load.
Alex W: filing internal incident doc I-202631555 with notes + attaching curl logs.
SupportOps: creating consolidated customer update and will post in #status-page once we have a timeline.
Ben T: saving prometheus snapshots and will share a gist of the stats for postmortem.
Alex W: thanks all :thumbsup: we should also add a mitigations runbook entry for tenant soft-cap and short-retry knob.
James C: agree. marking this thread resolved for now — reopening if errors resurge.
